---
title: "High contrast fixture"
format:
  revealjs:
    # A dark theme, so the page background behind the slides is not white to
    # begin with and the viewport assertion means something. The plugin's own
    # chrome is white whatever the theme, so the checks for it read the text
    # and border colours instead.
    theme: dark
    revealjs-plugins:
      - a11y
    revealjs-a11y:
      high-contrast: true
      alt-text-warnings: false
      pointer-indicator: true
---

## A slide

A paragraph, and a [link](https://example.com).
